Topic.label: Comparing and Calculating Angles (Including Angle Bisectors)

Question: Given \(\angle AOB=70^\circ\), \(\angle BOC=30^\circ\), and \(O, A, B, C\) lie in the same plane, what is the measure of \(\angle AOC\) in degrees? (If there are multiple answers, separate them with commas, in any order.)
Solution: Ray \(OC\) may lie outside \(\angle AOB\), giving \(\angle AOC=70^\circ+30^\circ=100^\circ\), or inside \(\angle AOB\), giving \(\angle AOC=70^\circ-30^\circ=40^\circ\). Both cases are possible.

Original.prompt: 已知 ∠AOB=70°，∠BOC=30°，且 O、A、B、C 在同一平面内，则 ∠AOC 的度数是多少？（有多个答案时用逗号隔开，顺序不限）
Original.explanation: 射线 OC 可能在 ∠AOB 外部（∠AOC=70°+30°=100°），也可能在 ∠AOB 内部（∠AOC=70°-30°=40°），两种情况都成立。
